business_summary.text: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited is an integrated metal producer with a diversified portfolio spanning steel, stainless steel, aluminium, ferro alloys, and power, focused on value-added downstream products.

call_points.text: Board approved a fresh capex of ₹2,700 crores comprising a specialty wire mill at Kharagpur and stainless steel expansion at Sambalpur.
Management expects volume growth and comfortable performance for FY27, targeting ~30% growth over the previous year.

operating_notes.text: Commissioned two new Annealing Furnaces (25 MT p.a. and 30 MT p.a.) and a 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator (LGSS) at the Pakuria facility.
Smel Steel Structural Pvt. Ltd. set up an aluminium flat rolled products (60,000 TPA) and foils (18,000 TPA) facility in Sambalpur, Odisha.
Proposed a ₹2,700 crore strategic growth expansion programme targeting Special Bar Quality (SBQ) and stainless steel downstream integration by 2029.
April 2026 sales release reports pig iron volume up 122.86% YoY to 93,345 MT and stainless steel volume up 10.89% YoY to 7,928 MT.
Approved ₹2,700 Cr capex for Long & Speciality Wire Rod and Bar Mill (Kharagpur) and Stainless Steel downstream expansion (Sambalpur) by March 2029.
ED issued provisional attachment order on ₹152.48 Cr of investments held by subsidiary Shyam SEL and Power Limited under PMLA.
Q4 FY26 volume grew by 22% YoY and revenue grew by 27% YoY.
Q4 FY26 sales volume stood at 4.94 million tonnes for FY26 reflecting 26% YoY growth.
May 2026 sales volume performance reflected strong growth in pig iron and CR coils driven by Jamuria plant additions.
Aluminium foil plant has order bookings for more than 10 months from existing foil plant.
Stainless steel business currently runs at ₹130-140 Cr run rate, expected to reach ₹600-700 Cr at 70-80% capacity.
Secured mining rights for Phutamura Coal Block through investment in Alom Solar Private Limited, holding ~170 million tonnes of coal reserves.
Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Shyam Sel and Power, had FY25 turnover of ₹91.75 Cr and accumulated losses of ₹20.47 Cr at 31 March 2025.

timeline.summary: Shyam Metalics expanded its Pakuria operations with the commissioning of two annealing furnaces (25 MT p.a. and 30 MT p.a.) and a 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator.
Shyam Metalics announced that its subsidiary's aluminium manufacturing facility in Sambalpur, Odisha is near commercial production.
Shyam Metalics proposed a ₹2,700 crore expansion programme in specialty steel and stainless downstream capabilities.
Shyam Metalics reported April 2026 monthly sales volumes showing strong YoY growth in pig iron, stainless steel, and pellets.

2026-05-11: Shyam Metalics approved a ₹2,700 Cr expansion plan in specialty and stainless steel, recommended a ₹2.70 per share dividend, and noted an ED provisional attachment of ₹152.48 Cr on subsidiary investments.
2026-05-11: Shyam Metalics reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹5,240 Cr up 27% YoY and PAT of ₹312 Cr up 42% YoY, alongside a ₹2,700 Cr capex approval.
Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited shared the audio recording of its Investors’ Conference Call for Q4 FY26 results on its website on May 12, 2026.
2026-05-16: Shyam Metalics reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹5,240 Cr up 27% YoY and PAT of ₹312 Cr up 42% YoY, approved a ₹2,700 Cr capex, and recommended a ₹2.70 per share dividend.
Shyam Metalics reported May 2026 monthly sales volumes showing strong YoY growth in pig iron and CR coils alongside volume drops in sponge iron and aluminium foil.
Q1FY27: Revenue ₹5,455 Cr (+23.3% YoY), EBITDA ₹812 Cr (+28.3%), PAT ₹351 Cr (+20.6%); interim dividend ₹1.8/share; aluminium foil facility commissioned.
2026-10-13: Shyam Metalics group secured strategic mining rights for the Phutamura coal block with ~170 million tonnes of reserves via investment in Alom Solar Private Limited.

NCLT Kolkata sanctioned the amalgamation of Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast Private Limited into Shyam Sel and Power Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) on 16 October 2026, effective on filing with the RoC, West Bengal.
